Theorem
[Existence of three-dimensional singularity models at all curvature scales] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0064, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0065 ↗ thm:chow-iv-canonical-neighborhood ↗ thm:chow-iv-no-local-collapsing 1. ch28:28.22\group Three-Dimensional Singularity Models

If $R(x_i,t_i)\to \infty $ in a finite-time singular flow on a closed three-manifold, a subsequence of $R_i g(t_i+R_i^{-1}t)$ converges to a $\kappa $-solution.
